newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.10 rupees up at 41.10 to the dollar on Tuesday in the kerb amid low demand for the U.S. currency, dealers said.
They said dollar demand was low but volumes were also down, which might help the rates to stay steady on Wednesday.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 2.90 percent, from previous close at 3.0 percent.
